title: Kenworth T909 Heavy Duty FUPS Compliant Road Train Bullbar #71
description: Kenworth T909 FUPS compliant Custom Built 5 post Road Train high tensile polished aluminium Bullbar. 88mm dia pipe, 100mm dia pipe available. All cross pipes are one piece 6mm wall high tensile pipe, no but welds. Heavy duty steel backing plate with tow pin. Full length 100mm wide reinforced uprights (additional internal gussets) Flip over Road Train signs on polished alloy plates with engraved KW logo, cowcatcher and 3 small uprights plus sump guard. Additional light bar mounted to bonnet. Bull bar can be custom built to your requirements.
